How to make friends
as an adult man
Turn acquaintances into friends with one invitation. The guy from the gym, the neighbour, the colleague you like. "Want to grab a beer Friday?" is all it takes.
Join something that repeats. A sports team, a climbing gym, a weekly class. Friendship needs repeated contact, and regular activities give you that for free.
Be the one who organises. Most men wait to be invited. Plan the poker night, the hike, the barbecue. People love the friend who makes things happen.
Share something real after a few meetings. A worry, a goal, a story about your family. A little openness turns a casual friend into a real one.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. You'll always bring something interesting to the table, and people will want you around.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. You'll always bring something interesting to the table.

slides.texte_overlay: Follow up between meetings. A funny meme, "How did the interview go?", a birthday message. Small, regular contact keeps the friendship warm between meetings.
Be patient. Adult friendships take time, often months. Keep showing up, and slowly the guy you met at the gym becomes the friend you call first.
